A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the self-diffusion of Ge in relaxed Si(1-x)Ge(x) layers is controlled by the vacancy concentration and the vacancy diffusion coefficient, which is independent of the Ge concentration.
the self-diffusion coefficients for (31)Ge, (31)Si, and (71)Si in Ge are the same within experimental uncertainties.
the activation enthalpy for Ge self-diffusion in Si(1-x)Ge(x) alloys is 3.6 +/- 0.1 eV, and the preexponential factor is (1.1 +/- 0.3) x 10(-2) m(2)/s.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the diffusion of (71)Ge and (31)Si in Si-Ge alloys can be studied by using (71)Ge as a substitute of (31) Si.
the diffusion of (31) Si in Ge-rich SiGe alloys may be studied using the (71) Ge radioisotope as a substitute for (31) Si.
(31)Si may be used as an effective radiotracer for the study of the self-diffusion of Si atoms in relaxed Si(1-x)Ge(x) layers.
